name: The Special Events
terms: This quotation is valid for 15 days from the date of issue.
50% advance payment is required to confirm the booking. Balance payment must be completed 7 days before the event date.
All prices are exclusive of GST. GST as applicable will be charged extra.
Any additional services or items requested after finalisation will be billed separately.
In case of cancellation, advance payment is non-refundable as per the cancellation policy shared at the time of booking.
Venue permissions, electricity and municipal approvals are the responsibility of the client.
The company is not responsible for delays caused by force majeure conditions including but not limited to weather, power failure, strikes or government regulations.
Props and décor items remain the property of the event company unless stated otherwise.
Any damage caused to venue property during the event will be billed to the client at actuals.
A final bill with actual usage will be shared within 3 working days after the event.
Both parties agree to resolve any dispute amicably under the jurisdiction of Rajkot, Gujarat courts.
